text:
jessica_cs: Heads up — Crestline renewal due in ~6 weeks. Noticed their prod API volume fell ~82% starting 2026-03-10. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/crestline
metrics-bot: ALERT: crestline-prod requests down 82% over 7d. Top endpoints affected: /generate, /embed. No increase in 5xx errors.
laura_csm: I reached out to Theo (their PM) yesterday. He said they're testing another vendor this month.
nate_sales: They mentioned Nimbus AI on the last commercial call. I logged a competitive pilot in SFDC. @jessica_cs are drops per-seat or per-key?
jessica_cs: Quick query shows the drop starts 2026-03-10 and is account-wide. No backend deploys or errors flagged.
mina_eng: Confirmed no deploys or infra regressions on that date. KV cache hit stable.
oliver_se: From support ticket: Crestline flipped a local routing config and started routing embeddings off-platform last Thursday. I attached screenshots.
jessica_cs: So this looks like partial migration + active Nimbus pilot. Proposed triage: 1) 1:1 with their new ML lead, 2) offer limited trial credit on Dedicated, 3) send short ROI/cost comparison.
nate_sales: Sales prefers a 6-week dedicated credit + joint tech session to highlight latency/cost controls. @mina_eng available Tue 10am PT for a deep-dive?
mina_eng: Yes, 45m slot works. We'll demo latency profiles, batching/quantization knobs, and a runbook for predictable cost.
laura_csm: I'll schedule and include sales + eng. Need to confirm procurement timeline (likely quarter-end).
jessica_cs: I'll draft a one-pager on cost + routing/fallback resilience and flag renewal risk as high for now.
oliver_se: Can metrics-bot produce per-route 30d latency & cost for Crestline and upload?
metrics-bot: Report generated: /shared/reports/crestline-per-route-30d.csv
nate_sales: I'll draft credit offer tied to the joint tech session; also propose an A/B pilot where heavier paths run on our Dedicated endpoints.
jessica_cs: Action owners: Laura — schedule meeting; Mina — tech deck & runbook; Oliver — attach config evidence to ticket; Nate — credit language; Jessica — cost comp & internal renewal note.
laura_csm: Invite sent to Theo for Tue 10am PT, included agenda and pre-reads.
finance-bot: Billing hold requires formal approval. @emma_finance to review any hold requests.
emma_finance: Acknowledge. Holds approved only for confirmed migrations or disputes; will coordinate scope with ops.
jessica_cs: Will only request a billing hold if Crestline asks. For now set renewal-risk = "high" until after the session.
laura_csm: I'll follow up to confirm whether they want vendor comparison ahead of the meeting.
jessica_cs: Thanks everyone — keep updates in this thread. If usage drops further before the session, we'll escalate. :+1:
